details: BNY is Circle's primary USDC reserve custodian and announced USDC custody, transfer, mint and burn capabilities on June 29, 2026.
BNY is Ripple's primary RLUSD reserve custodian and on October 27, 2026 announced XRP and RLUSD custody support for eligible institutional clients.
BNY is therefore a shared institutional service-provider node across separate Circle-USDC and Ripple-RLUSD/XRP relationships.
No direct Circle-Ripple partnership, joint reserve pool, cross-issuance or joint venture is established by these sources.
No BNY-specific XRP or RLUSD assets-under-custody balance, new XRP purchases or XRP collateral balances were disclosed.
RLUSD launched on Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase Retail on October 28, 2026.
Launch support covers XRPL, Base and Ethereum deposits/withdrawals, plus USD and supported stablecoin conversion.
Coinbase Global Exchange collateral eligibility was described as a future follow-up at launch, not an already completed capability.
Ripple said it would provide RLUSD liquidity on Base.
This is RLUSD distribution and does not establish XRP purchases or XRP collateral use.
Announced November 9, 2026.
Eligible PNC Corporate and Institutional Banking clients can receive USDC through Coinbase Payment APIs.
Incoming USDC is automatically converted 1:1 to USD and deposited into a designated PNC account.
Reuters independently describes the service as a limited pilot and confirms the USDC issuer is Circle.
This is a Coinbase-Circle-USDC-PNC rail, not XRP settlement or RLUSD distribution.
October 27, 2026 initiative proposes financing and settlement of approved receivables on XRPL using RLUSD.
Participating capital providers fund the early payment; XRPL is the settlement network and RLUSD the named settlement asset.
C2FO's current Instant Pay page still presents a waitlist and says rollout is limited over coming months, US-only at launch.
C2FO's historical $525B+ Early Pay working-capital figure is not Instant Pay funding, XRPL volume or XRP liquidity.
No production funded amount, throughput, XRP bridge use or XRP collateral was disclosed.
Standard Chartered DIFC Branch reports RLUSD custody on XRPL as live for eligible clients.
RLUSD collateral mirroring for LMAX products remains planned and subject to final documentation, testing, laws, internal approvals and jurisdiction readiness.
The named collateral instrument is RLUSD, not XRP.
